adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/office365calendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the old code used `refreshTokenResponseSchema.safeParse(responseJson)` and, on failure, only `console.error(...)` while continuing (keeping existing `o365AuthCredentials`). The new code calls `parseRefreshTokenResponse(responseJson, refreshTokenResponseSchema)`, whose implementation throws `new Error("Invalid refreshed tokens were returned")` when parsing fails. This is a real behavior change from log-and-continue to throwing/aborting on schema mismatch (though the claim of it being "silently" aborting is debatable since it throws an error).
